title: CRANE: Post-Hoc Counterfactual Retrieval for Multimodal Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2610.31594v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Counterfactual explanation methods have been introduced for unimodal settings, with dedicated frameworks for tabular, timeseries, text, and image data, yet no post-hoc method has been designed for classifiers that learn from multimodal inputs. Existing explainability methods for multimodal classifiers apply modality-specific attribution independently to each input, which fails to yield coherent explanations and does not transfer to arbitrary pre-trained multimodal architectures. translated_title: CRANE：面向多模态分类器的事后反事实检索
translated_abstract: 反事实解释方法此前已被引入单模态场景，针对表格、时间序列、文本和图像数据均有专门的框架，然而尚无针对从多模态输入中学习的分类器所设计的事后方法。现有的多模态分类器可解释性方法对每个输入独立地应用特定模态的归因，这不仅无法产生连贯的解释，也无法迁移到任意预训练的多模态架构上。为解决这些缺陷，我们提出了CRANE（Counterfactual Retrieval via Agnostic Nearest-neighbour Explanations，基于模态无关最近邻解释的反事实检索），这是首个用于最近邻多模态反事实生成的事后、模型无关框架。该框架从目标类别中检索真实训练样本作为候选解释，从而在构造上保证了解释的合理性。在四个异构数据集和三种融合策略上，我们展示了多模态共识检索（MC-R）……
tldr: 本文提出首个面向多模态分类器的事后、模型无关的反事实解释框架CRANE，通过从目标类别检索真实训练样本作为解释，在构造上保证了多模态反事实解释的合理性与连贯性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents CRANE, the first post-hoc, model-agnostic framework for multimodal counterfactual explanations, which ensures plausibility and coherence by retrieving real training examples from the target class as candidate explanations.
